author: Mikael Häggström
alt: Radiografia do tórax em tons de cinza, em formato vertical. Nos cantos superiores há as marcações de texto Dx, à esquerda de quem olha, e Sin, à direita.
descriptionFromSource: Posteroanterior chest radiograph ("X-ray") taken of a 21 year old woman who presented with pain on the left side of her thorax after colliding with another player during a soccer game. It shows a normal chest without any signs of injury. Dx and Sin stand for "right" and "left" respectively.

author: Mikael Häggström
alt: Radiografia do tórax em tons de cinza, em formato vertical. Não há marcações de texto visíveis.
descriptionFromSource: Lateral chest radiograph ("X-ray") taken of a 21 year old woman who presented with pain on the left side of her thorax after colliding with another player during a soccer game. It shows a normal chest without any signs of injury.
